free_tier.stated: No free compute hours are stated: each sandbox gets 20 GiB of local storage free of charge, persistent storage has a 10 GiB per account per month free tier, and network traffic is currently not billed separately.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the storage limit is a 20 GiB local disk per sandbox and a 10 GiB monthly persistent-storage allowance, not one object's size

retention.stated: Persistent storage billed hourly keeps templates and snapshots until deleted; billing continues when the sandbox is not running until the data is deleted.

egress.terms: Network traffic is currently not billed separately; sandboxes can make HTTP requests and database connections.

interface_detail: Fully compatible with the E2B SDK, with a simple SDK interface, management through command-line tools and full file-system operations including upload and download.
tooling: the official E2B SDK, a command-line tool and REST calls; Python, JavaScript/TypeScript and C++ are listed as supported languages.
chaining: A two-vCPU, 4 GiB sandbox at $0.020304 per vCPU-hour and $0.010152 per GiB-hour runs about $0.081 an hour, and its unmetered outbound traffic and S3-compatible object storage on the same account can carry results onward.

limits.value: 10 GiB of persistent storage per account per month free, then $0.00002727 per GiB-hour
20 GiB of local storage per sandbox free of charge; memory is configurable from 512 MiB to 8192 MiB in 512 MiB steps and vCPU from 1 to 8

binding_note: The 10 GiB monthly persistent-storage allowance is the only stated free quantity; compute is charged from the first second at $0.00000564 per core-second and $0.00000282 per GiB-second.

identity_cost.detail: unverified: an account is required, but no captured Sufy page states what registration asks for; the sign-up page (sufy.com/home) is a login wall and a JavaScript shell that every route failed to read, so email is a placeholder rather than an observed requirement

reliability_note: Running sandboxes are released when an account is in arrears and new instances cannot be created; persistent storage keeps billing until its data is deleted.
confidence_note: The rates, free allowances and egress term are quoted from the vendor's own sandbox overview read on 2026-11-25; the sign-up gate is not described on the pages read, so identity detail is unverified beyond the need for an account.
